title: Start a new estimate
answer: Tap the orange + at the bottom. Pick the type of work, then talk, type notes, add photos or scan the rooms. Tap Continue, answer the few questions (anything you skip uses a standard assumption) and tap Build estimate. Your prices, markup and tax are used automatically.

title: Measure a roof from satellite
vi: Đo mái nhà bằng vệ tinh
answer: Start a new estimate and choose Roof replacement. On the questions screen, enter the job address and tap Measure roof. You get the roof area, squares, pitch of every plane, roof shape, height, edge lengths and waste. Tap Use these numbers to fill the estimate. Always confirm on site before ordering materials.

title: Scan rooms in 3D
answer: On an iPhone with LiDAR (Pro models), tap Scan 3D on Home and walk the room slowly. The app draws the floor plan and fills in floor and wall areas. Without LiDAR you can type the room sizes on the Floor plan screen.

title: Edit the client quote before sending
vi: Sửa báo giá trước khi gửi
answer: Open the job in the Jobs tab, tap Client quote, then Edit. You can change headings, what is included, the scope summary, Not included, notes and how long the quote is valid, and choose a price per section or one total. Tap Help me write and Bidwell drafts the wording for you. To change the price itself, change the markup or Your items on the estimate.

title: Get the quote signed
answer: Open the job in the Jobs tab. Tap Sign to let the client sign on your phone, or Send a link to sign online so they sign on their own phone (you must be logged in). When they sign, the estimate is marked Won and you get a notice.

title: Add a change order
answer: Open the job in the Jobs tab, go to Contract & payments, and tap Add change order. Describe the work and price; the client approves it by signing on your phone or from a link. Approved change orders are added to the contract price.

title: Invoices and payments
answer: Open the job in the Jobs tab and go to Contract & payments. Create invoices from the payment schedule, record payments (cash, check, Zelle, card) and see what is still owed. Home shows the total to collect and anything overdue.

title: Automatic follow-ups
answer: Open a sent quote in the Jobs tab and tap Follow-ups. First record that the client agreed to be contacted (required by law), pick text or email, then set the days. Bidwell reminds you on those days between 8am and 8pm and stops when the client says no or the job is won or lost.

title: Job site photos, before and after
vi: Ảnh công trình, trước và sau
answer: Open the job (Jobs tab) and tap the big camera button at the bottom. Pick the area and Before, Progress or After, then take the photos. Each area has its own tasks your crew can mark Done or Needs review.

title: Send the client a photo update
vi: Gửi ảnh cập nhật cho khách
answer: Open the job and tap Send the client a photo update. Bidwell picks the newest photos and writes the message. Prices, costs and receipts are never included.

title: Crew, subs and work orders
vi: Thợ, thầu phụ và phiếu việc
answer: Add your people in Me > Crew & subs with their rate and language (English, Tiếng Việt, Español). On a job, Crew work order makes a task list in their language with no prices. Each morning Home asks if your crew showed up; Worked adds the labor cost to the job.

title: Job money and receipts (private)
vi: Tiền công trình và hoá đơn mua (riêng tư)
answer: Open the job and tap Money. Snap a receipt and Bidwell reads it, adds it to the job's costs, checks it off the buy list and learns your real prices. Receipts and profit are private: never on client or crew documents.

title: Schedule a visit or crew day
answer: Tap Schedule at the bottom, then +. Choose the kind (site visit, crew day, inspection…), the job, time and reminder, and pick the crew for crew days.

title: Change my prices, markup and tax
answer: Go to Me > My pricing for your price per square foot by finish level, markup, minimum markup and sales tax. The Price Book lets you change any labor rate or material price; every new estimate uses them.

title: Account, backup and a new phone
vi: Tài khoản, sao lưu và đổi điện thoại
answer: Your work is saved to your account automatically. On a new phone, install Bidwell and log in: your estimates, jobs and photos come back. Me > Account shows when it last synced.

title: Forgot password
answer: On the Log in screen tap Forgot password?, enter your email and open the link we send you. Choose a new password there, then log in again in the app. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive in a few minutes.

title: Delete my account and data
vi: Xoá tài khoản và dữ liệu
answer: Me > Account > Delete my account removes your account, your cloud data and all backed-up photos for good. Me > Erase removes the data on this phone.

title: How the AI works (and its limits)
answer: Bidwell's AI drafts estimates, quote wording and messages from your notes and photos, using your own prices. It can be wrong: always check quantities and prices before sending. Each account has a daily AI limit that resets every day.

title: Quotes in Vietnamese
answer: On the Client quote screen choose English or Tiếng Việt; each language can be edited separately. Crew work orders also come in Español.

title: QuickBooks, Google Sheets, Calendar
answer: Me > Connected apps sends won jobs, invoices and payments to your other tools through Zapier, Make or a webhook, and can export to a spreadsheet.
